question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.**
solution:
The correct answer is: **speak**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Speak **refers to utter words or articulate sounds, conveying thoughts, ideas, or information through verbal communication. (बोलना)

 
 
• **Example**: *Mary is always eager to speak at public events.*
 
 
 
• In the context of the sentence, the blank requires a verb that
